snippet.title: Mancalero Demo Release Trailer — October 2026 Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
The free Mancalero demo is live now on Steam!

Mancalero is registered for October 2026 Steam Next Fest, running October 19–26. Build a pouch of special marbles, sow explosive combos, and face bosses that change the rules in this roguelike board-game deckbuilder inspired by Mancala.

A substantial v1.02 update is coming with further balance, polish, and quality-of-life improvements. The full game is currently planned for November 4, 2026.

Play the demo and wishlist Mancalero on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4811700/Mancalero/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=nextfest_oct_2026&utm_content=demo_release_trailer

Press kit and media assets:
https://cerlus.github.io/mancalero-press-media-hub/

Follow me on Socials: https://linktr.ee/ArchiusDev

Developed by ArchiusDev.
